{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A fine wool blend coat, tailored fit, knee-length, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy woven wool.
A structured blazer, single-breasted with notched lapels, hip-length, dark navy (#000080), virgin wool.
High-waisted straight-leg trousers, full length, black (#000000), stretch cotton twill.
A crisp poplin button-down shirt, classic collar, cropped to hit the waistline, white (#FFFFFF), cotton poplin.
Minimalist gold stud earrings, small round hoops, champagne gold (#F7E7CE), 18k gold plating.
A structured leather handbag, medium size, black (#000000), smooth calfskin.
Ankle boots with a low block heel, pointed toe, black (#000000), calf leather.

This outfit honors your wish for a restrained and classic look while providing essential warmth against the frosty Saturday snow. The dark navy blazer paired with black trousers creates a sophisticated, elongated silhouette perfect for walking through the city center until evening. Wool and cotton fabrics ensure you stay comfortable in the cold without compromising on a neat, polished aesthetic suitable for socializing with friends."}
